message: Magic Control Ultra v6.4 is available with the complete Pro v2.4 feature set adapted to Ultra hardware.
notes: Magic Control Ultra v6.4 adds the standalone Force PWA at /force, six independent Force-enabled seed notes, hidden per-note list setup, persistent swap commands, corrected permanent-note dates, automatic Notes cache refresh and native-style note navigation. Ultra OLED wiring, battery monitoring, product branding, application icon and the separate Ultra OTA channel are preserved. Existing settings, Force lists, selected values, language, theme, user-created notes and the NVS namespace remain compatible and are not reset.
